tools.name: accessibility_html-audit
tools.description: Run the static image, heading, form, link, language, keyboard, ARIA, and inline-contrast checks. The result is not a WCAG conformance claim. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/accessibility/html-audit. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: accessibility_image-alt-text-audit
tools.description: Flag images, image inputs, and areas with no alt attribute. An empty alt is reported as a manual check, not as a confirmed failure. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/accessibility/image-alt-text-audit. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: accessibility_heading-structure-audit
tools.description: Read heading elements in source order and flag empty headings and skipped levels. A missing h1 is a potential issue, not a confirmed failure. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/accessibility/heading-structure-audit. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: accessibility_form-audit
tools.description: Check that controls have a label, an aria-label, or a matching label element. A placeholder or title is not treated as a sufficient name. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/accessibility/form-audit. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: accessibility_link-audit
tools.description: Flag links with no accessible name. Generic text such as click here is a potential issue because the surrounding sentence was not judged. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/accessibility/link-audit. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: accessibility_document-language-check
tools.description: Read the lang attribute on the html element. The page text is not compared with that value, and a fragment without html is not marked as a failure. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/accessibility/document-language-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: accessibility_keyboard-signals
tools.description: Flag a positive tabindex and an onclick on a non-control. Keys are not pressed, so keyboard operation stays a manual check. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/accessibility/keyboard-signals. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: accessibility_aria-attribute-audit
tools.description: Check roles, boolean ARIA values, and references to ids that exist in this HTML. Runtime ARIA state changes are not tested. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/accessibility/aria-attribute-audit. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: accessibility_color-contrast-check
tools.description: Calculate a contrast ratio only when both colours are opaque values on the same element. A single colour is not compared with an assumed background. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/accessibility/color-contrast-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: accessibility_remediation-report
tools.description: Combine the static checks and list confirmed issues before potential issues and manual checks. The report does not claim WCAG conformance. Price $0.12 USDC. POST /api/v1/accessibility/remediation-report. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "accessibility" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: accessibility_image-alt-text-audit, accessibility_heading-structure-audit, accessibility_form-audit, accessibility_document-language-check, accessibility_keyboard-signals, accessibility_aria-attribute-audit, accessibility_color-contrast-check, accessibility_remediation-report · Private data: accessibility_document-language-check · Public sink: accessibility_html-audit, accessibility_image-alt-text-audit, accessibility_heading-structure-audit, accessibility_form-audit, accessibility_link-audit, accessibility_document-language-check, accessibility_keyboard-signals, accessibility_aria-attribute-audit, accessibility_color-contrast-check, accessibility_remediation-report · Destructive: accessibility_html-audit, accessibility_image-alt-text-audit, accessibility_heading-structure-audit, accessibility_form-audit, accessibility_link-audit, accessibility_document-language-check, accessibility_keyboard-signals, accessibility_aria-attribute-audit, accessibility_color-contrast-check, accessibility_remediation-report.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
